text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
El Condor Pasa left behind an overwhelming record.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "World's Strongest." No one laughs off that proudly declared goal as a pipe dream anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—it was time to set out into the world.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Spe-chan, Grass!
I'm off, to France!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Have fun!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Have a good trip, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Geh?! W-Why are you just watching them leave,
Trainer-san?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you don't come too, Trainer,
it won't be a contest!
After all, what El is aiming for is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Tradition! Prestige! It is an international GⅠ heralded as the pinnacle of Europe, after all, YES!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just kidding," I lightly laugh. Of course,
I intend to accompany El Condor Pasa myself
and lead her to success.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Go for it, El-chan!!
You're definitely gonna win, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It won't be that simple. In all likelihood,
our opponents will be even stronger than at the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"And above all, that Umamusume will be running.
The champion of France, hailed as the strongest in Europe."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: B-But still, El-chan's way stronger, right!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mmm-, to be completely honest...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The other side is stronger, yes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, are you really okay with that?
Aren't you frustrated, El-chan?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It is not a matter of feeling frustrated or not.
I am merely speaking my mind, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look at that second burst of speed chasing relentlessly from behind!
She's an Umamusume who has won multiple graded stakes in Europe, after all, yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So El-chan can't win?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You can't win, can you~?♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If it were the El from last year.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El-chan, what do you mean until last year...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"If El hadn't stumbled last year and had gone
abroad straight after the Japan Cup,
she likely would have lost."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I used to run on pure talent alone.
But not anymore!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The strength honed and polished through competing alongside comrades.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A Trainer who travels on expeditions with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And above all else—
the cheers from the fans reaching across the ocean.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everything El lacked last year, she has now—
so much that I can barely hold it all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If we combine everything and fight together, there's no telling how it'll turn out.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, everyone will be happier if we give it our all and clash head-on.
Fans all over the world, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A one-winged condor. Perhaps that's what
El Condor Pasa used to be. Possessing nothing but raw talent."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But that's not the case anymore. Through battles with her friends,
El Condor Pasa has gained a magnificent pair of wings
—and takes flight toward the world.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass, Spe-chan.
I promise I'll bring the whole world to its feet!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I've already thought of what to say
when I win, yes!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What are you planning to say, El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The words Papa taught me...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El cóndor puede
volar más alto
que nadie.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El, Con...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, El-chan~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: In Spanish, it means this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "A condor can fly higher—than anyone else!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There is something far, far more wonderful than speed.
I'm going out there to show them!
